baslik: One blade longer than a football pitch: the 26 MW wind turbine 🌀 #shorts
aciklama:
Did you know? On Dongfang Electric's 26 MW test turbine, a single blade is 153 m long, the rotor is 310 m across and the swept area is about 77,000 m². The maker says it can generate about 100 million kWh a year at an average wind of 10 m/s, roughly the yearly electricity of 55,000 homes. For comparison: the NREL 5 MW reference turbine has a 126 m rotor.
Source: manufacturer announcement (September 2025), offshoreWIND.biz.

Narration uses an AI voice clone; visuals are code-generated 3D animation; music is an original AI-generated track.
